customer_message.body:
Good afternoon

As far as I can support: After the facade renovation my rent is going up substantially; The letter gives only a total and no understandable breakdown; this is how I recorded it.

Regarding “unclear renovation-related rent increase”, my notes show: the subsidies remains unresolved; for the request “check recoverable costs and the deadline”: key records are missing, so I cannot support every detail; on “unclear renovation-related rent increase”, I feel stressed but will not rush; also unresolved: the value adding share; these points make up my first report.

I am specifically asking for: check recoverable costs and the deadline; in particular, I need clarity about the value adding share and which missing record should be obtained first.

I need an initial view; Before acting I need to know the subsidies; I can then plan how to proceed.

I first noticed this on 11 February 2025.

Yours sincerely
